scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(!ua.includes('pnpm'))console.warn('[workspace] Tip: use pnpm install — this monorepo is set up for pnpm workspaces.\n');"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.dev:web: cross-env PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ API_PORT=5000 pnpm --filter @workspace/monitoring run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
